artworks.title: Saint Christopher Facing Right
artworks.description: The image shows an older man standing in water, holding a staff for support with a child on his shoulder. The man has a beard and curly hair, wearing layered clothing and a rope around his waist. The child has curly hair and a radiant light behind their head. In the background, another figure in robes is walking on a path with a staff and flaming torch. A building, possibly a church, is visible amid trees, with hills and water in the background. The central figures are illuminated by the sun.

artworks.title: Large Horse
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 16.6 x 11.8 cm (6 9/16 x 4 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man in armor riding a horse. The man is in profile, wearing a plumed helmet with a visor covering his face. His armor is detailed, and he appears authoritative. The horse, facing in a three-quarters view, looks composed and sturdy, with a groomed mane and tail. The background includes architectural elements and rough-hewn stone structures, suggesting a historical setting. The engraving is dated "1505."

artworks.title: Satyr Family
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 11.6 x 7.1 cm (4 9/16 x 2 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a nude woman seated on the ground, holding a child who is nursing. She is partially reclined against a tree. A male figure resembling a satyr is standing next to her, playing a musical pipe. The background is a dense forest setting with tall tree trunks and thick foliage. A wooden sign hangs from one of the trees with carved markings.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of the Ten Thousand
artworks.description: This is a print depicting various figures engaged in actions that suggest turmoil. In the background, on the left, is a tall hill covered with trees upon which some people appear to spear others. Some people fall off the hill on the right side, appearing to impale themselves on jagged branches on the ground below. On the far left, people with swords and whips seem to lead a group up the side of the hill. In the center, several people seem to be tied together around a tree. In the bottom left corner, more people appear to be in conversation, looking at the scene around them. The scene includes people in elaborate attire and varying kinds of headwear. The background on the right shows distant buildings and low hills, with birds flying in the clear sky.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint John
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures gathered around a central event of a figure immersed in a large cauldron. The artwork features elaborate details and expressions. The drawing showcases a variety of characters in diverse attire. The central figure in the cauldron appears distressed, as someone tends to a fire beneath, while other figures surround them, some appearing as observers, others engaged in the proceedings. The background is adorned with architectural and decorative elements.

artworks.title: The Beast with Two Horns like a Lamb
artworks.description: The image shows a scene of mythical creatures and celestial figures. A divine or royal figure is seated on a throne surrounded by winged angels amidst clouds. Below, a fearsome beast with multiple heads and crowns looms over a congregation of figures. Human figures in regal and religious attire huddle together, gazing at the mystical beings around them. The drawing is detailed, capturing textures and intricate linework and shading.

artworks.title: The Angel with the Key to the Bottomless Pit
artworks.description: This is an illustration featuring angels and a demonic creature in a detailed medieval cityscape. The angels have large wings and flowing robes, while the demonic creature has horns and scales. In the background, there is a city surrounded by hills and mountains. Two angels in the sky observe the scene, and the city includes towers, bridges, gates, and a winding river. The drawing is done in a dense line style reminiscent of woodcuts.

artworks.title: Christ on the Mount of Olives
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting several figures in a rocky landscape. The central figure is kneeling near rocks, with hands clasped in prayer. An angelic figure above offers a cup, with detailed wings. Other figures rest in robes nearby. In the background, a city with a domed building and a body of water with a wooden causeway. The surrounding landscape is detailed with trees and plants. The style is reminiscent of Albrecht Dürer.

artworks.title: The Resurrection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure standing with a staff. The image shows a central figure emerging from a tomb, with radiant lines emanating from their head. Surrounding the central figure are guards in distress or unconscious, and there are clouds and celestial figures in the background. The drawing is detailed with fine lines, typical of woodcut techniques.

artworks.title: The Deposition
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people gathered around a central figure. The drawing is intricately detailed in a monochromatic color scheme. The scene features various expressions and interactions among the figures, set against a mountainous landscape with trees and a sky. A crucifix can be seen in the far left of the composition. The style resembles that of Albrecht Dürer, showing detailed linework and a blend of movement and stillness within a historical or religious context.

artworks.title: Saint Sebaldus Standing on a Column
artworks.medium: woodcut with letterpress on thick laid paper

artworks.title: Joachim's Offering Rejected
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a courtroom scene. The image shows a group of people in an enclosed architectural space with a vaulted ceiling and intricate brickwork. The figures are dressed in elaborate attire and stand around a large table covered with a cloth. Some individuals appear to be in positions of authority. A chandelier hangs low from the ceiling and a sword is mounted on the brick wall. The drawing emphasizes detail in clothing and architectural features.

artworks.title: Joachim and the Angel
artworks.description: The image shows a winged figure and a man interacting in a forest setting. The angel is suspended in mid-air, wearing a long flowing garment. The man is in a full-body pose, reaching out towards the angel. A secondary figure is also present. In the background, there are sheep grazed under the watch of shepherds, and a distant body of water with small boats. The setting has tall trees and detailed textures.

artworks.title: Joachim and the Angel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in a forest with rustic surroundings, distant water, and hills. The artwork features an angelic figure with large wings descending towards the ground, interacting with a robed figure with hands raised towards the angel. The setting is a dense forest with intricately drawn trees. In the background, there is a pastoral landscape with sheep grazing and a village near a body of water, with small boats and distant hills. The scene is detailed with fine lines and meticulous detailing, resembling woodcut or engraving styles. The composition conveys a sense of narrative, spiritual significance, and historical context.

artworks.title: Joachim and Anna at the Golden Gate
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural setting with figures and landscape. The artwork shows an interior scene framed by an archway. Inside, there is a group of figures. The architecture includes arched openings and brickwork. A landscape with hills, trees, and distant structures is visible beyond the walls. The design features detailed textures and patterns, particularly in the clothing of the figures and decorative borders.

artworks.title: Joachim and Anna at the Golden Gate
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures standing near an archway and a distant landscape. The image features a variety of figures in flowing robes, two of whom appear to be embracing in the foreground. The scene is framed by an intricately detailed architectural archway adorned with ornate patterns and designs. To the left and behind the arch, several other figures are depicted in dynamic poses, seemingly in observance of the main figures in the embrace. In the background, detailed trees and a distant view of a castle atop a hill are visible, creating a sense of depth. The drawing is rendered in fine lines and cross-hatching. The style and execution suggest it reflects the precision and detail commonly seen in works from the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: The Birth of the Virgin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an indoor scene with an angel and several figures engaged in various domestic activities. The image depicts a room bustling with activity, where multiple figures are attending to tasks around a central bed. A hovering angel figure appears amidst clouds at the upper part of the image. The architecture and furnishings, such as a staircase, fireplace, and wooden interior, add depth and context to the scene. The lower area shows figures interacting, possibly engaged in conversation and domestic work. The drawing has intricate lines and details.

artworks.title: The Presentation of the Virgin in the Temple
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in an architectural setting with arches and columns. The drawing contains intricate line work and depicts an interior scene with multiple figures. The architecture includes classical elements such as rounded arches and decorative columns. In the foreground, there is a cluttered table with items on it, and what appears to be a basket of food on the floor nearby. In the open space, various individuals stand engaged in conversation or looking on towards the center, while one figure carrying a torch stands elevated at the back, overlooking the entire scene. The space is highly detailed, suggesting a significant gathering within a grand, classical architectural setting.

artworks.title: The Betrothal of the Virgin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures dressed in historical clothing participating in a ceremonial scene inside an ornate architectural setting. The central focus of the drawing is the elaborate archway adorned with intricate carvings and detailing. Within the archway, a group stands engaged in what appears to be a formal or religious ceremony. The figures are situated in a grand interior space with towering columns and a domed ceiling. The outer frame of the image emphasizes the architectural grandeur with a wood-cut print quality. The detailed linework and shading create depth and texture throughout the composition, showcasing the craftsmanship and style associated with early Renaissance illustrations or woodcuts.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in a detailed architectural setting. One figure is an angel kneeling with wings extended, while the other figure is seated, with long hair covered by a veil, wearing a long robe. The seated figure has one hand on their chest and another holding a book on a lectern. Above the seated figure, a dove is depicted. The background features masonry arches, an outdoor landscape with trees, and a cloudy sky visible through an opening. The architecture includes arches, a staircase, intricate stonework, and shadows for depth.

artworks.title: The Visitation
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor scene with mountains in the background. The foreground shows an engagement at the entrance of a building, with figures positioned around the arched doorway. There are figures outside interacting, and a dog is laying on the ground near them. The background features hills, a castle, and mountain peaks under a cloudy sky, surrounded by trees to the right. The style is reminiscent of German Renaissance woodcuts.
